templates.name: acordo_quitado
templates.description: The cycle closed with the receivable paid, told outside the 24-hour window. The normal collections case: the debtor agrees on Tuesday and pays on Friday, and by then this is the only message WhatsApp will carry. {{1}} is the agreement alias, which is also the only agreement this conversation may name.
templates.body: Oi! Recebemos o pagamento do {{1}} e ele esta quitado. Obrigado!

templates.name: acordo_cobranca_vencida
templates.description: The receivable reached its due date unpaid. The same message the terminal sends free-form, and it has to be its own template: a debtor whose charge expired must not be told the agreement is settled. {{1}} is the agreement alias.
templates.body: Oi! A cobranca do {{1}} venceu sem pagamento. Se quiser, emito uma nova dentro das mesmas condicoes.

buttons.title: Emitir nova
buttons.intent: quero que voce emita uma nova cobranca para o meu acordo

buttons.title: Agora nao
buttons.intent: agora nao quero uma nova cobranca para o meu acordo

templates.name: acordo_cobranca_cancelada
templates.description: The receivable was cancelled, so nothing was paid and nothing is owed on it. {{1}} is the agreement alias.
templates.body: Oi! A cobranca do {{1}} foi cancelada e nada foi pago. Qualquer coisa, e so falar por aqui.

templates.name: atendimento_atualizacao
templates.description: The FALLBACK: sent by a poll, outside the 24-hour window, when an outcome closed that the agent has no template of its own for (a charge the rail failed to issue, a proposal denied or expired days later). It states NOTHING about the outcome, so it can never be the wrong news; it asks the person to answer, and an answer reopens the window, inside which the agent says what happened in free text. Takes no variables.
templates.body: Oi! Temos uma atualizacao sobre o seu atendimento. Responda esta mensagem para continuarmos por aqui.

buttons.title: Falar agora
buttons.intent: quero saber qual e a atualizacao do meu atendimento
